mina_partner_ops: Quick heads-up 1: our HW partner RackSmith is flagging mismatches between "marketplace reported" and our internal ingestion for their "dedicated-appliance" SKUs. Differences are per-customer and vary daily.

arjun_partnerships: Do they provide raw usage webhooks or are they uploading CSVs via the marketplace?

mina_partner_ops: They push webhooks to our marketplace ingestion endpoint. They also occasionally upload retrospective CSVs for on-prem installs. Sample from their ops team attached: customer=RS-77, subscription=rs_ded_77, rs_reported=4500, our_count=5200, date=2026-03-15.

claire_eng: Two likely problems: time-window alignment (marketplace uses 00:00 UTC window) and our dedupe/keying logic for on-prem appliances that sometimes replays identical payloads. Also wondering if their appliance firmware clocks drift.

omар_billing: typo? (omар_billing -> omar_billing)

mina_partner_ops: oops fixed above.

metering-bot: Alert: discrepancy spike detected for partner RackSmith across 12 subscriptions. Generated ticket TCK-20260323-3.

claire_eng: Can we get one of their raw webhook deliveries? Need to check presence of request_id, event_id, and whether they include batch_size.

mina_partner_ops: RackSmith shared a raw payload snippet:```json
{"subscription_id":"rs_ded_77","window_start":"2026-03-15T00:00:00-07:00","units":4500,"event_uuid":"","batch_size":4500}
```

arjun_partnerships: Noticed window_start includes timezone offset. If they use local midnight the payload will straddle UTC days.

claire_eng: For on-prem CSV backfills, they sometimes upload daily files with cumulative counters, not deltas. If they send cumulative counters but we treat them as deltas, we overcount. Need to detect 'counter' vs 'delta' semantics.

tess_pm: Action items: 1) Engineering to run per-subscription time-series diff and detect repeated cumulative patterns; 2) Partnerships to request firmware clock check and standardize on ISO UTC timestamps; 3) Billing to prepare forecast impact.

arjun_partnerships: I'll set up a short runbook for partners with best practices: always include event_uuid, include delta vs cumulative flag, use UTC ISO timestamps, avoid replays during backfills.

claire_eng: I'll prototype a heuristic: if successive daily payloads show non-decreasing cumulative totals, convert to delta by subtracting the prior known value, but only apply if event_uuid missing. This will be opt-in for partners until we confirm with RackSmith.

omar_billing: Preliminary financial exposure estimate: ~$9.2k overstatement if we don't fix this for March. We'll hold credits until partner confirms their data model.

mina_partner_ops: RackSmith says their appliances were recently updated and may have sent cumulative counters by mistake. They've agreed to provide a mapping doc and a backfill CSV with deltas.

metering-bot: Ticket TCK-20260323-3 status: assigned -> engineering.

claire_eng: Quick audit result: for rs_ded_77, our raw ingestion shows spikes on 2026-03-10..2026-03-20 matching cumulative uploads. Converting to deltas reduces our count from 52,000 to 45,000 for that range.

arjun_partnerships: RackSmith will resend corrected deltas starting tomorrow 06:00 UTC and will stop cumulative uploads.

tess_pm: Great. Keep thread updated. We'll treat this as a partner onboarding improvement and update docs.
